COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
27.07.2023 SPA No. 223 of 2023 
Hon’ble Vipin Sanghi, C.J.
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Yogesh Kumar Pacholia, learned 
counsel for the appellant. 
2. Mr. Amarendra Pratap Singh, learned 
Additional Advocate General with Mr. 
Gajendra Tripathi, learned Brief Holder for
the State / respondent Nos. 1, 3 and 4. 
3. Mr. Prem Prakash Bhatt, learned 
counsel holding brief of Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, 
learned counsel for respondent No. 2. 
4. Issue notice. 
5. Counsels appear and accept notice on 
behalf of respondent Nos. 1 to 4. 
6. Issue notice to respondent No. 5, 
returnable on 14.02.2024, by all permitted 
modes, including electronically. 
7. In the meantime, we direct the served 
respondents to file their respective counter￾affidavits, which should deal with the 
averments and the documents made in the 
writ petition, as well as the averments and  documents filed along with the present 
appeal. The District Magistrate, Haridwar 
shall also explain his inaction on the 
complaint of the petitioner, copy whereof has 
been filed along with the writ petition, as 
Annexure 5 dated 28.10.2022. 
8. List the matter on 14.02.2024. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) (Vipin Sanghi, C.J.)
